title: The service owns the port
prompt:
Implement `PasswordResetService(notifier)`:

- `notifier` is ANY object with `send(to, message)` (define a `Notifier` Protocol in the solution for documentation)
- `reset(user, token)` sends `'reset token: <token>'` to `user['email']` and returns True
- a user without an email raises `ValueError('user has no email')`
- the service must never import or name a concrete vendor — graded by running it against two DIFFERENT notifier implementations
